# TSN.ca

> > Canada's leading sports network covering NHL, CFL, NFL, and national sports with live scores, highlights, and expert analysis.

TSN (The Sports Network) is Canada's premier sports media destination, featuring comprehensive coverage of hockey (NHL), Canadian football (CFL), and international sports. The site provides real-time scores, breaking news, video highlights, and expert commentary from journalists like Matthew Scianitti.

## Key Topics

- NHL (National Hockey League)
- CFL (Canadian Football League)
- NFL coverage
- Canada Soccer
- St. Louis Blues
- Robert Thomas
- Cleveland Browns
- Green Bay Packers
- Houston Texans
- Detroit Lions
- BarDown hockey entertainment
- Trade tracker
- Live scores and highlights
- Sports betting and fantasy

## Core Sports Coverage

- [TSN - Canada's Sports Leader](https://tsn.ca): Homepage featuring latest NHL, NFL, CFL news and scores from TSN Canada
- [NHL Scores, News & Highlights](https://tsn.ca/nhl): NHL section with scores, highlights, trade tracker, and team news from TSN
- [2025 CFL Schedule - Football](https://tsn.ca/cfl/schedule): 2025 CFL season schedule with scores, standings, and team information
- [TSN | BarDown](https://tsn.ca/bardown): BarDown section featuring hockey entertainment, Team Canada, and World Juniors

## Sports News & Analysis

- [Edmonton Elks 'optimistic' about their future despite missing playoffs](https://tsn.ca/cfl/article/elks-optimistic-about-their-future-despite-missing-playoffs): CFL article on Edmonton Elks QB decisions with Cody Fajardo and Tre Ford
